propositions: Every CI job makes an avoidable network call to raw.githubusercontent.com to fetch uv version manifest because setup-uv falls back to LatestVersionResolver when no version is pinned locally
setup-uv action is SHA-pinned at 25 call sites across 12 workflow files but uv itself lacks a version pin in pyproject.toml or uv.toml, causing the version resolution to hit the network
Adding [tool.uv] required-version = '==0.12.7' to pyproject.toml eliminates the version-resolution manifest fetch by matching ExactVersionResolver instead of LatestVersionResolver
A guard script validates that the uv pin remains exact and consistent across all workflow call sites, preventing per-site version inputs from silently diverging CI behavior
The residual artifact-URL manifest fetch by setup-uv's getArtifact call remains present even after version pinning and is tracked separately
